56008-mire-io-a-provenc-al-poem.title: _A Provençal Poem._
56008-mire-io-a-provenc-al-poem.creator: Frédéric Mistral.
56008-mire-io-a-provenc-al-poem.description: A book by Frédéric Mistral.. The employment of a rustic southern dialect for the purposes of poetic narrative was by no means so unheard-of a thing, even to the men of that generation, as was indirectly assumed by the first reviewer of “Mirèio.” Had not Jacques Jasmin, the immortal barber of Agen, written, in his own local _patois_, “Françonette,” and “The Blind Girl of Castel Cuillé,” and the inimitable “Papillotes”?

arxiv-2011-04949.title: Soliton, Breather and Rogue Wave Solutions for Solving the Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation Using a Deep Learning Method with Physical Constraints
arxiv-2011-04949.creator: Juncai Pu, Jun Li, Yong Chen ∗
arxiv-2011-04949.description: Abstract . The nonlinear Schrödinger equation is a classical integrable equation which contains plenty of significant properties and occurs in many physical areas. However, due to the difficulty of solving this equation, in particular in high dimensions, lots of methods are proposed to effectively obtain different kinds of solutions, such as neural networks, among others.

arxiv-2109-12140.title: Vertebrate interval graphs
arxiv-2109-12140.creator: Rain Jiang, Kai Jiang, Minghui Jiang
arxiv-2109-12140.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Rain Jiang, Kai Jiang, Minghui Jiang. A vertebrate interval graph is an interval graph in which the maximum size of a set of independent vertices equals the number of maximal cliques. For any fixed v ≥ 1 v\geq 1 , there is a polynomial-time algorithm for deciding whether a vertebrate interval graph admits a vertex partition into two induced subgraphs with claw number at most v v .

arxiv-2203-04407.title: Controlling the volume fraction of glass-forming colloidal suspensions using thermosensitive host ‘mesogels’
arxiv-2203-04407.creator: J.S. Behra, A. Thiriez, D. Truzzolillo, L. Ramos, L. Cipelletti
arxiv-2203-04407.description: Abstract The key parameter controlling the glass transition of colloidal suspensions is φ \varphi , the fraction of the sample volume occupied by the particles. Unfortunately, changing φ \varphi by varying an external parameter, e.g. temperature T T as in molecular glass formers, is not possible, unless one uses thermosensitive colloidal particles, like the popular poly( N -isopropylacrylamide) (PNiPAM) microgels.

arxiv-2204-11598.title: Mining Root Cause Knowledge from Cloud Service Incident Investigations for AIOps Conference: 44nd International Conference on Software Engineering: Software Engineering in Practice; May 21–29, 2022; Pittsburgh, PA, USA 44nd International Conference on Software Engineering: Software Engineering in Pr
arxiv-2204-11598.creator: Amrita Saha, Steven C.H. Hoi
arxiv-2204-11598.description: Abstract . Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of any service-disrupting incident is one of the most critical as well as complex tasks in IT processes, especially for cloud industry leaders like Salesforce. Typically RCA investigation leverages data-sources like application error logs or service call traces.

arxiv-2209-06263.title: Connecting low-energy CP violation, resonant leptogenesis and neutrinoless double beta decay in a radiative seesaw model
arxiv-2209-06263.creator: Bikash Thapa and Ng. K. Francis
arxiv-2209-06263.description: Abstract We present a study of resonant leptogenesis in a radiative seesaw model. We consider the case where two quasi-degenerate right-handed neutrinos realize resonant leptogenesis, and the CP violation necessary to achieve leptogenesis occurs through the CP phases present in the neutrino mixing matrix.

arxiv-2401-06687.title: Proximal Causal Inference with Text Data
arxiv-2401-06687.creator: Jacob M. Chen, Rohit Bhattacharya, Katherine A. Keith
arxiv-2401-06687.description: Abstract Recent text-based causal methods attempt to mitigate confounding bias by estimating proxies of confounding variables that are partially or imperfectly measured from unstructured text data. These approaches, however, assume analysts have supervised labels of the confounders given text for a subset of instances, a constraint that is sometimes infeasible due to data privacy or annotation costs.

arxiv-2401-11265.title: Assessing the Competitiveness of Matrix-Free Block Likelihood Estimation in Spatial Models
arxiv-2401-11265.creator: Alfredo Alegría
arxiv-2401-11265.description: Abstract In geostatistics, block likelihood offers a balance between statistical accuracy and computational efficiency when estimating covariance functions. This balance is reached by dividing the sample into blocks and computing a weighted sum of (sub) log-likelihoods corresponding to pairs of blocks. Practitioners often choose block sizes ranging from hundreds to a few thousand observations, inherently involving matrix-based implementations.

arxiv-2406-01447.title: Linear and nonlinear propagation of cylindrical vector beam through a non-degenerate four level atomic system
arxiv-2406-01447.creator: Partha Das 1,, Tarak Nath Dey 1,
arxiv-2406-01447.description: Abstract We investigate the phase-induced susceptibilities for both components of the probe vector beam (PVB) within an atomic system. The atoms are prepared in a non-degenerate four-level configuration. The transitions are coupled by a π \pi polarized control field and two orthogonally polarized components of a PVB.

arxiv-2406-09533.title: Investigation of Q Q degradation in low-loss Si 3 N 4 from heterogeneous laser integration Journal: ol
arxiv-2406-09533.creator: Joel Guo, Chao Xiang, Warren Jin, Jonathan Peters, Mingxiao Li, Theodore Morin, Yu Xia, John E. Bowers
arxiv-2406-09533.description: Abstract High-performance, high-volume-manufacturing Si 3 N 4 photonics requires extremely low waveguide losses augmented with heterogeneously integrated lasers for applications beyond traditional markets of high-capacity interconnects. State-of-the-art quality factors ( Q Q ) over 200 million at 1550 nm have been shown previously; however, maintaining high Q Q s throughout laser fabrication has not been shown.

arxiv-2410-17474.title: Rare Event Classification with Weighted Logistic Regression for Identifying Repeating Fast Radio Bursts
arxiv-2410-17474.creator: Antonio Herrera-Martin, Radu V. Craiu, Gwendolyn M. Eadie, David C. Stenning, Derek Bingham, Bryan M. Gaensler, Ziggy Pleunis, Paul Scholz, Ryan Mckinven, Bikash Kharel, Kiyoshi W. Masui
arxiv-2410-17474.description: Abstract An important task in the study of fast radio bursts (FRBs) remains the automatic classification of repeating and non-repeating sources based on their morphological properties. We propose a statistical model that considers a modified logistic regression to classify FRB sources.

arxiv-2505-15141.title: BanditSpec : Adaptive Speculative Decoding via Bandit Algorithms
arxiv-2505-15141.creator: Yunlong Hou, Fengzhuo Zhang, Cunxiao Du, Xuan Zhang, Jiachun Pan, Tianyu Pang, Chao Du, Vincent Y. F. Tan, Zhuoran Yang
arxiv-2505-15141.description: Abstract Speculative decoding has emerged as a popular method to accelerate the inference of Large Language Models (LLMs) while retaining their superior text generation performance. Previous methods either adopt a fixed speculative decoding configuration regardless of the prefix tokens, or train draft models in an offline or online manner to align them with the context.

arxiv-2603-05563.creator: Diego Vallarino

britannica-1911-bullinger-heinrich.title: Bullinger, Heinrich (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-bullinger-heinrich.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-bullinger-heinrich.description: Article 'Bullinger, Heinrich' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 4), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of Cappel (11th of October 1531), in which Zwingli fell, he left Bremgarten. On the 9th of December 1531 he was chosen to succeed Zwingli as chief pastor of Zürich. A strong writer and thinker, his spirit was essentially unifying and sympathetic, in an age when these qualities won little sympathy.

plos-pone-0002000.creator: Anavaj Sakuntabhai, Rokhaya Ndiaye, Isabelle Casadémont et al.
plos-pone-0002000.description: PLOS ONE research article. Plasmodium falciparum malaria episodes may vary considerably in their severity and clinical manifestations. There is good evidence that host genetic factors contribute to this variability. To date, most genetic studies aiming at the identification of these genes have used a case/

pmc-10544618.title: Mediating effect of body fat percentage in the association between ambient particulate matter exposure and hypertension: a subset analysis of China hypertension survey
pmc-10544618.creator: Yan Xue, Jin Li, Yu-Nan Xu, Jia-Sheng Cui, Yue Li, Yao-Qiong Lu, Xiao-Zhi Luo, De-Zhao Liu, Feng Huang, Zhi-Yu Zeng, Rong-Jie Huang
pmc-10544618.description: BackgroundHypertension caused by air pollution exposure is a growing concern in China. The association between air pollutant exposure and hypertension has been found to be potentiated by obesity, however, little is known about the processes mediating this association. This study investigated the association between fine particulate matter (aerodynamic equivalent diameter ≤ 2.5 microns, PM2.

pmc-10708216.title: Antifungal and Phytotoxic Activities of Isolated Compounds from Helietta parvifolia Stems
pmc-10708216.creator: Victor Pena Ribeiro, Joanna Bajsa-Hirschel, Prabin Tamang, Kumudini Meepagala, Stephen O. Duke
pmc-10708216.description: The identification of natural and environmentally friendly pesticides is a key area of interest for the agrochemical industry, with many potentially active compounds being sourced from numerous plant species. In this study, we report the bioassay-guided isolation and identification of phytotoxic and antifungal compounds from the ethyl acetate extract of Helietta parvifolia stems.

pmc-11323548.title: Laterality, heterotaxy, and isolated congenital heart defects
pmc-11323548.creator: Carolina Putotto, Flaminia Pugnaloni, Marta Unolt, Giulio Calcagni, Paolo Versacci, Bruno Marino
pmc-11323548.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). To date, the role of NODAL in normal and abnormal L-R asymmetry has been well established. In a recent paper, mutations of this gene have been reported in heterotaxy but also in transposition with D- or L-ventricular loop.

pmc-11348648.title: Moving an exercise referral scheme to remote delivery during the Covid-19 pandemic: an observational study examining the impact on uptake, adherence, and costs
pmc-11348648.creator: Katie Newby, Neil Howlett, Adam P Wagner, Nigel Smeeton, Olujoke Fakoya, Nigel Lloyd, Imogen Freethy, Charis Bontoft, Katherine Brown, Mary-Ann McKibben, Annie Petherick, Wendy Wills
pmc-11348648.description: BackgroundExercise Referral Schemes (ERSs) have been implemented across Western nations to stimulate an increase in adult physical activity but evidence of their effectiveness and cost-effectiveness is equivocal. Poor ERS uptake and adherence can have a negative impact on effectiveness and cost-effectiveness and, if patterned by socio-demographic factors, can also introduce or widen health inequalities.

pmc-11357143.title: Introducing and Boosting Oxygen Vacancies within CoMn2O4 by Loading on Planar Clay Minerals for Efficient Peroxymonosulfate Activation
pmc-11357143.creator: Xue Yang, Xiao Yao, Yinyuan Qiu
pmc-11357143.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). CoMn2O4 (CMO) has been recognized as an effective peroxymonosulfate (PMS) activator; however, it still shows disadvantages such as limited reactive sites and metal leakage. Herein, an effective and environmentally friendly composite catalyst, CMO/Kln, was synthesized by anchoring CMO on kaolinite (Kln), a natural clay mineral with a special lamellar structure, to activate peroxymonosulfate (PMS) for the degradation of residue pharmaceuticals in water.

pmc-11596133.title: First Insights into the Fecal Metabolome of Healthy, Free-Roaming Giraffes (Giraffa camelopardalis): An Untargeted GCxGC/TOF-MS Metabolomics Study
pmc-11596133.creator: Andri Grobbelaar, Gernot Osthoff, Ilse du Preez, Francois Deacon, Baichuan Deng
pmc-11596133.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives: This study provides the first insights to the fecal metabolome of the giraffe (Giraffa camelopardalis). By using untargeted metabolomics via gas chromatography time-of-flight mass spectrometry (GCxGC/TOF-MS), this study primarily aims to provide results of the impact that external stimuli, such as supplemental feeding (SF) practices, seasonal variation and sex, might have on the fecal metabolome composition of healthy, free-roaming giraffes.

pmc-11672844.title: Effects of Replacing Fishmeal with American Cockroach Residue on the Growth Performance, Metabolism, Intestinal Morphology, and Antioxidant Capacity of Juvenile Cyprinus carpio
pmc-11672844.creator: Xiaofang Zou, Chenggui Zhang, Bingyan Guo, Yu Cao, Yongshou Yang, Peiyun Xiao, Xiaowen Long, Seunghyung Lee
pmc-11672844.description: Simple SummaryThis study evaluated the potential of substituting fishmeal with American cockroach residue in the feed of juvenile Cyprinus carpio. Replacing up to 40% of fishmeal with American cockroach residue significantly improved growth performance, antioxidant capacity, and immune function in juvenile C. carpio. However, replacing more than 40% of fishmeal may adversely affect intestinal health.

pmc-12748364.title: Nanomedicine and nutraceutical-based nanocarriers for specific delivery to cancer stem cells: targeted drug delivery at the STEM frontier
pmc-12748364.creator: Enas Daoud, Waleed K. Abdulsahib, Sajida Hussein Ismael, R. Roopashree, Subhashree Ray, Jayshree Nellore, Gunjan Mukherjee, Ashish Singh Chauhan, Mohigul Kholiyeva
pmc-12748364.description: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) represent a highly plastic and therapy-resistant subpopulation within tumors, driving tumor initiation, progression, metastasis, and relapse. Their ability to evade conventional treatments necessitates novel, highly specific therapeutic strategies. Nanomedicine offers a transformative approach to overcome the limitations of traditional therapies by enabling targeted and controlled drug delivery.

pmc-13037090.title: Investigation of university students’ oral health attitudes, behaviors, and habits: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13037090.creator: Muhammet Fidan, Mustafa Fidan
pmc-13037090.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDeveloping positive attitudes toward oral health is critical for improving general health and hygiene. This study aimed to examine the relationship between university students’ oral health attitudes, behaviors, and habits.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted in Turkey using convenience sampling. The Oral Health Attitude Scale (OHA-S) was applied alongside questions on socio-demographic factors and oral health attitudes and behaviors, including oral hygiene habits such as tooth brushing, flossing, dental visits and and toothbrush replacement frequencies.

pmc-13211214.title: Tomato Ripeness Detection and Localization Based on the Intelligent Inspection Robot Platform
pmc-13211214.creator: Xinrui Li, Long Liang, Yubo Liu, Jingxia Lu
pmc-13211214.description: The field inspection and ripeness detection of tomatoes in China remain heavily dependent on manual labor, while existing robotic solutions often exhibit limited functionality, poor environmental adaptability, prohibitive hardware costs, and unstable positioning accuracy. To address these limitations, this study proposes an intelligent tomato inspection robot that seamlessly integrates real-time ripeness recognition with precise spatial localization.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In case an individual who dies before the making of any award to which such individual may be entitled, as authorized in this chapter, the award may be made and presented within five years from the date.
